Topic · A short framing line

Emotion is a landscape, not a list.

A richer vocabulary can describe distinct feelings without forcing them into separate boxes.

27 dimensions · continuous experience01 / 04
02 · The central idea

More than one feeling can be true.

A useful model makes room for mixed experiences. Joy and sadness, for example, can both be present at once and at different intensities.

Takeaway: Coexisting feelings are part of the model, not an exception.
